important: Every ansatz factor is exp(theta B) for a physical one- or two-body fermionic generator B that preserves exact S=1/2. No projected U^H A U surrogate is used as a different physical circuit generator.

pool_diagnostics.definition: complete nonzero generalized rank-1/rank-2 physical generators obtained as the spin-preserving null space within each spatial remove/add group

pruning_note: 50 is the smallest passing ansatz found in this reconstruction. A 49-operator magnitude-pruned neighbor converged to 1.6311165 mEh, just above threshold. This is not a proof that no other <=49-operator sequence can pass.
